Name: Horsefriendly Town
Author: DevilBro
Description:
Not much to say, this mod changes the town appearnce, so that you are able to freely move around with
your horse, since your horse sometimes is too fat to squeeze through some fences or bushes.

Just unzip it and move the Content Folder into your Stardew Folder. it should overwritte the town.xnb

If you think that more paths should be made wider for your horse, feel free to message me and I will add them.
Thought, I won't move every small bush just because you are too lazy to walk around it, just huge path blockages please.

Downloads.Description: Changes the town to be able to freely ride your horse
